:::{#sol-rss-hessian}

Differentiate each first derivative again.

**Derivatives of $\derivfslash{\text{RSS}}{\intcoef}$.**
By @exr-rss-deriv-intercept,
$\derivfslash{\text{RSS}}{\intcoef}
= -2 \paren{n \outbar - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \predbar}$.
Differentiating with respect to $\intcoef$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dderivf{\text{RSS}}{\intcoef}
&= -2 \deriv{\intcoef}
  \paren{n \outbar - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \predbar}
&& \text{(constant factor)}\\
&= -2 \paren{
  \derivf{(n \outbar)}{\intcoef}
  - \derivf{(n \intcoef)}{\intcoef}
  - \derivf{(\coef{x} n \predbar)}{\intcoef}}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= -2 (0 - n - 0)
&& \text{(differentiate each term)}\\
&= -2 (-n)
&& \text{(drop the zeros)}\\
&= 2n
&& \text{(multiply)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Differentiating with respect to $\coef{x}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\xderivf{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}{\intcoef}
&= -2 \deriv{\coef{x}}
  \paren{n \outbar - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \predbar}
&& \text{(constant factor)}\\
&= -2 \paren{
  \derivf{(n \outbar)}{\coef{x}}
  - \derivf{(n \intcoef)}{\coef{x}}
  - \derivf{(\coef{x} n \predbar)}{\coef{x}}}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= -2 (0 - 0 - n \predbar)
&& \text{(differentiate each term)}\\
&= -2 (-n \predbar)
&& \text{(drop the zeros)}\\
&= 2 n \predbar
&& \text{(multiply)}
\end{aligned}
$$

{{< slidebreak >}}

**Derivatives of $\derivfslash{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}$.**
By @exr-rss-deriv-slope,
$\derivfslash{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}
= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)$.
Differentiating with respect to $\intcoef$,
and reusing the inner derivative $-1$ from @exr-rss-deriv-intercept:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\xderivf{\text{RSS}}{\intcoef}{\coef{x}}
&= -2 \deriv{\intcoef} \sumin \predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(constant factor)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \deriv{\intcoef} \paren{\predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs \deriv{\intcoef} (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{($\predvar_\iobs$ does not depend on $\intcoef$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs (-1)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-1$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin (-\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= -2 \paren{-\sumin \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= 2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= 2 n \predbar
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Differentiating with respect to $\coef{x}$,
and reusing the inner derivative $-\predvar_\iobs$ from @exr-rss-deriv-slope:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dderivf{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}
&= -2 \deriv{\coef{x}} \sumin \predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(constant factor)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \deriv{\coef{x}} \paren{\predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs \deriv{\coef{x}} (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{($\predvar_\iobs$ does not depend on $\coef{x}$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs (-\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-\predvar_\iobs$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \paren{-\predvar_\iobs^2}
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= -2 \paren{-\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= 2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2
&& \text{(multiply)}
\end{aligned}
$$

{{< slidebreak >}}

**The matrix.**
Collecting the four second derivatives gives the matrix of second derivatives:

$$
\begin{pmatrix} 2n & 2 n \predbar \\ 2 n \predbar & 2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

:::
